questions.question: What are the possible states of a time card in ServiceNow Time Card Management?

options.text: Pending, Submitted, Approved, Processed, Rejected, Recalled

explanation.correct: Time cards can have six states: Pending (not submitted), Submitted (submitted for approval), Approved, Processed (approved with expense line created), Rejected, and Recalled (approved card returned for adjustments).

wrongAnswers.explanation: These are not the correct time card states
These are generic task states, not time card specific states
These are not the correct time card states

source.excerpt: A time card can have any of the following states: Pending, Submitted, Approved, Processed, Rejected, Recalled.

questions.question: What task types does the time card management feature work with? (Choose FOUR)

explanation.correct: The time card management feature works with the Task table to record time worked on Projects, Incidents, Problems, and Change Requests. Knowledge Articles and Service Catalog Items are not task types that support time card entry.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Knowledge Articles are documentation, not tasks that support time card entry
Service Catalog Items are request types, not tasks that support time card entry directly

source.excerpt: The time card management feature works with the Task table to record time worked on Projects, Incidents, Problems, and Change Requests.

questions.question: What happens when you approve a time card in ServiceNow?

options.text: The time card is deleted and hours are transferred to the task
The time logged is saved day-wise in the Time Card Daily table
A notification is sent to the submitter only
The time card is automatically closed

explanation.correct: When you approve a time card, the time logged in the time card is saved day-wise in the Time Card Daily [time_card_daily] table. This enables generating time card reports by days for any period irrespective of the time sheet period.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Time cards are not deleted upon approval; they are retained with the Approved state
While notifications may be sent, the key action is saving daily time data
Approved time cards move to Approved state, not automatically closed

source.excerpt: When you approve a time card, the time logged in the time card is saved day-wise in the Time Card Daily [time_card_daily] table.
